items.name: Light vinaigrette / olive oil dressing
items.preparation: tossed through the leaves (implied by the slight shine)

scale_cues: Used the white square plate, about 25 cm across, to judge size. The salad is a loose pile about 12 x 16 cm and only a few centimetres high, so the greens take up a lot of space but weigh little.
assumptions: The greens are mostly arugula with some other baby leaves.
The orange strips are shredded raw carrot.
The leaves look a little shiny, so I assumed a light coat of oil or vinaigrette. I can't see any pooled dressing, so it may have none, which would make the total about 14 kcal.
No croutons, cheese, nuts or protein are visible.
Only one plate is in view and I could see no drink.
